# Meditech Components

> Meditech Components is a medical equipment supplier based in India, providing ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified AEDs, ambulance stretchers, and evacuation wheelchairs to hospitals and healthcare professionals. Meditech Components is a sister concern of Ajil Fibretech Pvt. Ltd., bringing over 20 years of ambulance manufacturing expertise to its medical device catalog.

Meditech Components supplies medical devices for patient care and emergency response across India, including:
- Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs) for emergency cardiac response
- Ambulance stretchers built for durability in transit
- Evacuation wheelchairs designed for fast, safe patient movement

## Products

- [All Equipment](https://meditechcomponents.com/products): Full catalog of medical devices, filterable by category, brand, and certification.
- [AEDs](https://meditechcomponents.com/products?category=AED): Automated External Defibrillators from certified manufacturers.
- [Ambulance Stretchers](https://meditechcomponents.com/products?category=Stretcher): Patient transport stretchers for ambulance and hospital use.
- [Evacuation Wheelchairs](https://meditechcomponents.com/products?category=Wheelchair): Wheelchairs designed for patient evacuation and transport.

- [About Us](https://meditechcomponents.com/trust-center): Company background, certifications, and trust information.

## Certifications

Meditech Components products carry ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and CE Mark certifications depending on the product line.
